confidenceBps.description: Written only by producers that can mean it (the extractor). An explicit save keeps it NULL, and surfaces render unknown — never a fake number.

conflictGroup.description: Records making competing claims about one subject share this key. At most one member of a group is active, so a packet can never carry two.

evidenceCount.description: How many signals (kept, edited, dropped or fixed findings) back the record. Absent means none.

expiresAt.description: When set, the instant after which the record stops applying. The sweep closes the interval at this instant rather than at the moment it ran.

layer.description: `memory` or `taste`. Absent on the wire means `memory`, so a memory reads exactly as it did before layers existed.

outcomeScore.description: Taste rules only: how well the rule has held up. It rises when what it shaped is kept and falls when it is dropped. Absent means 0.

pathGlobs.description: Taste rules only: the paths a rule applies to, as globs. Absent means every path in its scope.

pausedReason.description: Taste rules only: why a paused rule paused.

pinned.description: Taste rules only: kept from pausing or expiring on its own.

supersedes.description: Set when this record replaced an earlier one through supersede.

validFrom.description: The instant this record's claim began to hold. Validity is an interval, not a flag: a record that never reached active carries an empty one, where `validTo` equals `validFrom`.

validTo.description: The instant the claim stopped holding. Absent while the record is active; a supersession, a tombstone, or an expiry closes it, and a closed record stays queryable as history.

description: Every taste rule in one status, in every repository, newest change first.

neverUsed.description: Rules given to at least ten reviews and cited by none.
